item.description: BBH India managing director Himanshu Saxena has been given additional responsibility as President - North & East for Saatchi & Saatchi India and Propagate. item.title: Prime Video rolls out Moviesphere+ as an add-on subscription in India
item.description: Prime Video has added Moviesphere+, a Lionsgate-owned service, as a new add-on subscription option in India. The service is available at an introductory price of Rs 399 per year and is expected to offer subscribers access to a library of Hollywood films, classics and new TV shows. item.title: Tennis Premier League signs three-year streaming partnership with JioHotstar
item.description: The Tennis Premier League (TPL) has signed a three-year agreement with JioHotstar, which will become the league’s official streaming partner beginning with Season 7. The deal is expected to expand digital access to live matches, highlights, and other content as tennis viewership grows in India. TPL is played in a 25-point format intended to simplify the game for wider audiences. item.title: Gen AI to generate $621 bn in productivity for India; 30% to be SMBs: Report
item.description: India is heading into 2026 with a surge in entrepreneurial activity, according to LinkedIn’s latest Small Business Work Change India Report. item.title: India’s internet ad market to more than double to $13.06 billion by 2029: Report
item.description: PwC India’s latest Global Entertainment & Media Outlook 2025-29 forecasts strong growth for the country’s entertainment and media (E&M) sector, projecting expansion from $32.2 billion in 2024 to $47.2 billion in 2029. The 7.8% compound annual growth rate (CAGR) is nearly double the global average of 4.2%. item.title: Print ad space grows 3% in Jan-Sept 2025 as education & auto lead: Report
item.description: India’s print advertising market recorded a 3% rise in ad space in January-September 2025 compared with the same period last year, according to new data from TAM AdEx. The report shows sustained activity across sectors, with education, auto and services emerging as the top contributors. The education sector led print advertising with a 17% share, followed by auto at 16% and services at 15%. Banking/finance/investment accounted for 11%, while retail captured 8%. item.description: Project Worldwide has opened its India/South Asia ‘Project Hub’ in Bengaluru, bringing together several of its agencies under one integrated operational centre. item.title: Dream11 shifts from gaming to second-screen entertainment sports platform

The company, in a statement, said the revamped platform will offer creator-led live match watch-alongs, interactive reaction and banter features, and free-to-play fantasy sports.
